title: Are We Aligned? A Preliminary Investigation of the Alignment of Responsible AI Values between LLMs and Human Judgment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs across four tasks (selecting key responsible AI values, rating their importance in specific contexts, resolving trade-offs between competing values, and prioritizing software requirements) and comparing the models' preferences to the judgments of AI practitioners and a US-representative sample using Spearman's rank correlation.
